message.content:
Based on the full-page screenshot provided, here is the description of the visible sections from top to bottom:

**1. Hero Section**
*   **Status:** **Rendered Content Present.**
*   **Details:** Features a large, bold, outlined typography of the name "DYMAS ALFIN" spanning across the top. A black-and-white portrait photo of a man with glasses is positioned overlapping the text (specifically over the "A" in "ALFIN"). Below the name is the title "UI/UX Designer," a short bio paragraph, a "Let's collaborate" link, and social media buttons for Dribbble, Instagram, and LinkedIn on the right.

**2. Marquee / Stats Section**
*   **Status:** **Rendered Content Present.**
*   **Details:** Located immediately below the hero intro. It displays four key statistics in a row: "40+ SHIPPED PROJECTS", "9y+ DESIGNING PRODUCTS", "12 INDUSTRIES SERVED", and "4 DESIGN SYSTEMS BUILT". Above this row is a horizontal scrolling marquee line containing keywords like "Research", "Design Systems", "Prototyping", "Motion", etc., separated by diamond icons.

**3. Selected Work Section**
*   **Status:** **Rendered Content Present.**
*   **Details:** Titled "Selected Work" with a subtitle "40 projects shipped". It contains a grid of project cards.
    *   **Layout:** The grid uses a masonry or varied-size layout.
    *   **Cards Visible:**
        *   "Lumen Banking" (Large card, yellow background).
        *   "Northwind Studio" (Tall card, pink background).
        *   "Field Notes OS" (Green background).
        *   "Verde Market" (Purple background).
        *   "Atlas Travel" (Blue background).
        *   "Orbit Health" (Large card, orange/peach background).
    *   Each card includes a year (e.g., 2025, 2024), project title, category tags, description text, and specific technology tags at the bottom. There is a "View full case studies" button at the bottom of the section.

**4. What I Do Section**
*   **Status:** **Rendered Content Present.**
*   **Details:** Titled "What I Do" with subtitle "4 service lines". It features a 2x2 grid of service cards:
    1.  **Product Design:** Describes end-to-end design from discovery to delivery. Tags: User Flows, Wireframes, etc.
    2.  **UX Research:** Covers evidence-led decisions and user behavior. Tags: User Interviews, Usability testing, etc.
    3.  **Design Systems:** Focuses on scalable, documented systems. Tags: Token architecture, Component library, etc.
    4.  **Brand & Identity:** Visual identity and strategy. Tags: Logo & marks, Type system, etc.

**5. Experience Section**
*   **Status:** **Rendered Content Present.**
*   **Details:** Titled "Experience" with subtitle "9+ years designing". This is a timeline or list layout with horizontal rows separating different roles:
    *   **Senior Product Designer** at Northwind Labs (2023 – Present).
    *   **Product Designer** at Atlas Travel (2021 – 2023).
    *   **UI/UX Designer** at Verde Studio (2018 – 2021).
    *   **Freelance Designer** Independent (2016 – 2018).
    *   Each row includes the date range on the left, the role/title in the center-bold, the company/location below it, and a description paragraph on the right.

**6. Kind Words Section**
*   **Status:** **Rendered Content Present.**
*   **Details:** Titled "Kind Words" with subtitle "From teams I shipped with". Displays three testimonial cards in a row:
    *   Quote from **Priya Nair** (VP Product, Northwind Labs).
    *   Quote from **Marco Bianchi** (Founder, Atlas Travel).
    *   Quote from **Sara Lindqvist** (CEO, Verde Market).
    *   Each card has quotation marks, the testimonial text, and the person's name/role at the bottom.

**7. Contact Section (CTA)**
*   **Status:** **Rendered Content Present.**
*   **Details:** A distinct section with a light gray background (or white depending on interpretation, but visually separated). It contains the heading "LET'S BUILD SOMETHING", a large bold headline "Have a product that needs a clear, usable interface?", a subtext about taking on projects, an email link "hello@dymasalfin.com", and a "Book a 30-min call" button. Below this text block, there is a massive, bold typographic element that reads "**hello?**" which acts as a visual footer to this section.

**8. Footer**
*   **Status:** **Rendered Content Present.**
*   **Details:** A standard footer bar at the very bottom. It contains the logo/name "Dymas Alfin" with location "UI/UX Designer · Jakarta, ID" on the left. The center holds copyright "© 2026 — All rights reserved" and tech stack credits "Built with Next.js, GSAP & Framer Motion". The right side has a "Back to top" button with an arrow.

**Layout Bugs / Overlapping Text:**
*   **Hero Overlap:** In the Hero section, the portrait image intentionally overlaps the large "ALFIN" text. While likely a stylistic choice, it is a significant overlap.
*   **Contact Typography:** In the Contact section, the word "hello?" is extremely large. Depending on the viewport width, this might clip or push content, though in this static view, it appears contained within its section boundary.
*   **General Layout:** The rest of the sections (Work, Services, Experience, Testimonials) appear cleanly laid out with proper grids and spacing; no unintended overlapping text is observed there.
